The '''second battle of DS 5''' was a conflict during the [[Battle for Honor]] campaign in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]], an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] officer who defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], was using the Rebel outpost [[DS 5]] to gain supplies for his [[Admiral Harkov's fleet|forces]]. However, this was prevented by an Imperial raid earlier.Upon locating Harkov, [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Gunboats]] from Mu group returned the system near Rebel outpost DS 5. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] reported the transit of various cargo vessels bound to Harkov's location. The [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order]], wanted [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] to inspect the convoy to know what supplies were critical to Harkov's fleet.

==The battle==
[[File:Attack_on_the_DS_5_convoy.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The battle]]
Equipped with [[Proton rocket/Legends|heavy rockets]], the Gunboats emerged from hyperspace almost twenty kilometers from DS 5 and the [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] (the admiral's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]), lying in wait for anything that may arrive to re-supply the traitor Harkov. Three bulk freighters from [[Karflo]] arrived first, immediately seized upon by the four Gunboats from Mu, one of which piloted by Maarek Stele, aided by four additional Gunboats from Rho group as backup. Stele inspected the freighters to find supplies inside before the freighters were all destroyed. In the moments to come, Imperial Gunboats inspected and destroyed two [[Modular conveyor|Modular Conveyors]] [[SoroSuub (CNVYR)|SoruSuub]] containing [[Water/Legends|water]] and [[Hydrazine]], [[Container transport|Container Transports]] ''[[Morgath 1]]'', containing spares & ''[[Morgath 5|5]]'', containing munitions and two [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] ''[[Sundog]]'', containing [[Trooper/Legends|troops]].

By the time Imperial starfighters could destroy the arriving convoy, [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] from [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''Protector'' had closed the distance on Gunboats Mu and Rho. Outclassed and out gunned Imperial fighters offered a brief show of force by destroying a few of the far superior Avengers, then escaped to the safety of lightspeed.

==Aftermath==
The destruction of the convoy was a blow to Harkov's fleet. Now the next step was to take out his starfighter superiority with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] capable [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. It is Battle 5 Mission 3.

This article assumes completion of both "Primary" and "Secondary" objectives. The "Bonus" objectives include inflicting casualties on Harkov's TIE Advanced squadrons, all A-wings destroyed, hitting the ''Protector'', inspecting at one of the supply containers near the ship and destroying all [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] [[AAA Tow]], [[A1 Tow]] and [[A2 Tow]]. These can't be achieved unless the player replaces Heavy Rockets with [[Advanced concussion missile]]s.
